narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -6.86 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 864.74-870.08 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 908.07; the first objective pays 0.93R at 855.40.

plan.triggerRule: footprint div fired sell in short direction at the zone
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 908.07 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.93 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 35/100 — flow fading, liq magnets below, funding crowded

factors.name: Liquidation Gravity
factors.detail: long liq $776 -0.6% below · short liq $314 +3.9% above
